forms:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Hey! Ever seen me swim?! I’m, like, super fast, yo! <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>I dunno
if ANYONE’S faster than me in the water!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh yeah? Well, I know a ton of different swimming strokes.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>One-handed? Two-handed? No-handed? No problem!
I can do it all!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh yeah?! Well, uh... I can <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>swim with ease even when the
water’s crazy rough!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)>What?! Well, I’m a fearsome fighter! Feast your eyes on
these fierce fists!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Which one of us is cooler?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... I guess we should listen to
<$cdef(27)>
here, yo.

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,663)>Hmph! Well, I’m still not convinced.<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)>
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,48)>Besides, I’m not the one who started this bragfest—that
was all you, pal!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>W-well, y’know, I thought it’d be fine to talk myself up a
bit, yo!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re so cool when you swim, <$cdef(27)>Poliwrath... I just wanted a
li’l friendly competition...

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>That so? I didn’t know you felt that way...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>Well, I gotta admit, you are pretty speedy.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)>Awww, <$cdef(27)>Poliwrath</color>...

<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,666)>Say, <$cdef(27)>Wartortle...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>We should go swimmin’ together sometime. I’ll teach ya
some of my tricks.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Y-yeah! That sounds awesome, yo! I’m lookin’ forward to it!
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,817)>Kyuuuooon!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yoooooo! Your tails are SO beautiful! Like...overflowing
with beautifulness!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,815)>Kyuuun... *fwoosh!*

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>No matter what angle I look at ’em from! Beautiful! Just
beautiful! Thanks so much for showin’ ’em off to me!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>You certainly know how to deliver praise, <$cdef(27)>Wartortle</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>My pleasure, yo! I’m just super thankful that I get to see
your <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>beautiful tails, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>Think nothing of it. After all, I also got to see something
<$voicel(2,6)>quite lovely.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huh? Somethin’ lovely? What do you mean?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Every time you got enthusiastic, your tail wagged.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>That fluff, those curly tufts... It was absolutely adorable!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Awww, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales! Thanks, yo! I think I’m gonna take a page
out of your book <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>and try to get my tail all beautiful too!

<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Hahaha! That sure was a good competition we had there,
<$cdef(27)>Greninja! You’re pretty good at this, if I do say so myself!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,1)>Indeed. I feel very fortunate to have met a worthy rival
with whom I can hone my skills.
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,9)>I look forward to more of this in the future with you.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Heck yeah! Let’s do it! Of course, it goes without sayin’
that I won today’s water-blastin’ competition...
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,815)>But I’mma have to step up my game next time! Yes sirree!

<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,6)>...Excuse me? I believe you’ll find that I was the
victor today.

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,10)><$comeff(1,22)>What?! Were you even watchin’, buddy? <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)>I clearly blasted
water farther’n you!

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,7)>Preposterous! My record was a full leaf’s length farther
than yours!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Perhaps your eyes have grown weak, <$cdef(27)>Blastoise?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)>Heh heh... You young’uns sure know how to twist things to
make yourselves look better than you are.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,9)>What you need, my friend, is to look at things with a li’l
more objectivity!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Put any sheet of iron in front of me, and my Hydro Pump’ll
blast clean through it! Losin’ just ain’t an option for me!

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Hahaha! If your aim is to send water flying a great
distance, there’s no need for brute strength like yours.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,10)>What’s truly important is skill and technique.

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(2,653)>Grrr... You really know how to run yer mouth! We’ll settle
this once ’n’ fer all next time!
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,817)>I would have it no other way!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Servine, you collect berries with your vines, right?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,666)>That’s so awesome! I’m jealous.

<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Huh... Is it really that cool? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,815)>All I do is aim at a target and
hit it with <$cdef(27)>Vine Whip...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>I can do that with my tail, but it can’t stretch out like your
vines. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,663)>I wish I could reach faraway stuff like you...

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh... Well, thanks.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>But you’re better at hide-and-seek than me, <$cdef(27)>Ekans. I can
never seem to find you!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>You got that right—no one has a sneakier slither than me!
Plus I’m super good at staying still and silent!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>Yup, I’m pretty much a hide-and-seek pro!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>So you’re using that thin, long body of yours to sneak
around, huh? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Maybe I should try slithering like you...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,666)>Huh?! You wanna copy ME? Wow, you’re gonna make
me blush!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Guess I gotta keep practicing if I wanna stay the
supreme sneak!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Yeah! I’ll do my best to keep up, too!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>If we play hide-and-seek together a bunch, <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>do you think
your body’ll get long like mine?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Hehe... That’d be amazing if it did!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$textsize(2)>Ssshaaa!!!</textsize>
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Oh, hiya, <$cdef(27)>Arbok</color>!
Uh...<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> How come you’re not scared? <wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Ain’t you afraid of me?

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Huh? Why would I be scared? You just wanna be friends,
don’tcha?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Wh-WHAT?! Where’d ya get that idea from?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Wha—?! Am I wrong? I was CERTAIN you were scarin’
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>everyone ’cause you just wanted to talk to them...
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Er, no way, that’s not... I’m, uh... You got it all wrong, pal!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Awww... Really?
<$voicel(2,5)>’Cause I really wanted a friend too, so when you came and
went “Ssshaaa!” at me, <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)>I was so happy...

<$emotion(1,27)>For real?!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>...Psh, well, if that’s how ya feel, guess I got no choice—
starting today, you and me are pals, pal!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Really? REALLY really?! Yayyy! OK, you ’n’ me are
officially friends now, <$cdef(27)>Arbok!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)>Ugh... This is the worst...
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>Oh, what’s the matter, <$cdef(27)>Trapinch</color>, dear?

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Hi, <$cdef(27)>Raichu. Get a load of this!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Earlier, someone left a huge burn mark on my home!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh no! That’s a terrible thing to do!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>I’ll be sure to give whoever did that to you a real earful!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Thanks, but the thing is...I’ve got no clue who did it.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,47)>By the time I noticed, they were already gone.

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,15)>Oh dear, the culprit must be a sneaky one!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Did you notice anything else at the time, <$cdef(27)>Trapinch?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh yeah! I heard this loud noise, like KZZZAP! It sounded
kinda like electricity.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Who coulda done something like this? And why? I don’t
get it at all...

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$textsize(0)>That...sounds like when I discharged electricity into the ground earlier.

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>Huh? Did you say something?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Wait, do you know who did this?!

<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Oh, er... Y-yes, dear! Exactly...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>I’ll tell that scoundrel <$voicel(1,4)>not to do that again near your home...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Wow, thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>Raichu</color>! I’ll leave that to you!
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>Ahahahaha...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)>*stare*...
Ahem! <$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,9)>Mrrrowwwr!

<$emotion(1,27)>Whoa...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Ahem! ...Yi-yip!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Awww... I just can’t roar as elegantly as you do, <$cdef(27)>Persian!
<$lookat(2,1,1)><waitactor(2)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>What’s this? A little copycat? How darling!

<$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Well, yeah... Your fur’s all glossy and beautiful and...
I wanna be like you...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>I’m trying to copy what you do, but it’s so hard!
I just wanna become a lovely Pokémon already...

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, I see. But there’s no need to rush that, little one.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>From what I can tell, you already possess the makings <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>of
a lovely, refined adult.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huh?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Your constant desire to improve yourself, <$cdef(27)>Vulpix. Never
forget the determination I see burning within you.

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Yeah!
<$voicel(1,5)>I’m gonna keep trying hard to be <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>a lovely Pokémon just
like you, <$cdef(27)>Persian!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Why, if it isn’t <$cdef(27)>Flygon</color>. How nice to see you.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh. Hello there, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales</color>.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>I must say, the sound your wings make when they flap is
quite lovely. Like listening to a beautiful serenade.
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>Though it can be a bit noisy...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,1)>Why, thank you. How very kind.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Those tails of yours are quite marvelous as well. They have
a sort of elegant mystique that’s utterly captivating.
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)>Despite looking unwieldy and uncomfortable.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)>Thank you—it takes a great deal of effort to maintain their
beauty. I find that daily grooming is an absolute must.
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>How nice it must be to exist without regard for one’s
appearance, especially covered in desert sand.

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>That must be quite burdensome. Despite how they look,
my wings are sturdy <$motionoff(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>and allow me to fly about freely.
<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)>Which I doubt would be possible if I had to drag a bulky,
hairy tail around...
<$comcan(2)>...<wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>You know, I feel like we have a lot in common. ♪

...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>I think you may be right. This feels like the start of
a wonderful friendship! ♪

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Gosh, your legs are awesome, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag! You can use them
to walk on land, right?
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Well...yeah! <$voicel(1,6)>I can only walk real slowly, though.

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Ugh... Even that makes me super jealous...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>I wanna have legs too! I wanna try WALKING!

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oooh, OK. I understand.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Me, I’m jealous of those things called hands! I bet carrying
berries and stuff is a lot easier with those things!

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,27)>Yeah, for sure!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Like, <$cdef(27)> has hands and uses them
to
make
all
SORTS
of stuff!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Yeah! They also mess around with those human tools, too.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I wish I could do that...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>I wonder if I’ll ever grow hands ’n’ feet... <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>And it’d be sooo
cool if YOU grew hands right along with me, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>No kidding. I hope that happens some day...
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,29)>Uh, hey, umm... Are you awake?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>...Yup, I’m awake.

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Oh cool, you ARE awake!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>You always look like you’re asleep, so I’ve never been sure
if I could talk to you or not...

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Oh, you can talk to me anytime...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,50)>By the way, your tummy makes this cool-looking
swirly pattern...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Yeah, pretty neat, isn’t it?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>I really love this swirly pattern I’ve got! It’s all swirly!

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Swirly-whirly... Swirly-whirly... S-swirlyyy...whirlyyyyyy...
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,16)>Gosh, I’m getting sleepier ’n’ sleepier looking at that...

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Oh, uh, don’t fall asleep on me! Maybe you shouldn’t look
at my belly...

<$comeff(2,15)><$voicel(2,3)>... ... ...
Zzzzzz...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)>Aww, Abra, come back!
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>*sigh*
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Why the long face?

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, it’s just... Sometimes I glitch out and kinda...lose
control, I guess.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>I wish I could do something to stop it from happening.
Don’t suppose you have any ideas?

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Why not try bending a spoon with your mind? It requires
you to center your focus and mental energy.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Mastering the art should give you better control of your
mental state, leading to fewer outbursts.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>Huh, interesting idea! But...how do I do that?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Take a look at this spoon, and try to telepathically transmit
your thoughts to it.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,14)>Calm your mind, center your energy, and with enough
focus...<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>the spoon should bend on its own.

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,27)>Got it. All right, I’ll give it a try!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,14)><$motionoff(2,804)>Hmmm... Nggghhh... <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,663)>This is harder than I thought. <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,661)>Could
you give me a quick demonstration?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Sure thing. Look closely at my hand, and... <wait(0.4)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)>Hrngh... HAAA!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,14)>Incredible! I can feel your telekinetic power growing much
stronger... It’s practically overflowing!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,827)>Huh?! O-O-Oh no, I fe-fe-feel a gli-gli-glitch coming on...
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)>C-C-Can you c-c-cut it out?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)>Hrrrngh... HAAAAAA!!!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,10)>ArE#*&\\y0u”%++L-L-LiSteNinG?%=#&*@!

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)>Phew... Anyway, that’s all there is to it. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Whoa! Are you
all right?! <$voicel(1,6)>Looks like you’re having an outburst!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Quick, focus on bending the spoon!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,815)>I tHiNk*@%th-th-thAt’s#>thE%+]]p-p-pr0bLeM...$%&=
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Heh heh. It’s just as I foresaw.
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$cdef(27)>Alakazam</color>. What is up?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, nothing significant. I was merely reflecting on my
weather prediction—which turned out to be correct.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,666)>That makes ten days in a row.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Ah. Weather forecasting. What method do you use?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh heh. Through training my psychic powers, I’ve
gained the ability to foresee things.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>What could be better than being able to see the future
